title: Julianna Townsend - I Won’t Wait
htmlContent:
Emerging artist Julianna Townsend delivers a brand new single, "I Won't Wait," a unique and outstanding R&B melody that feels definitive the first time you hear the song. The track has paved the way for her impressive songwriting skill in the music industry. Julianna Townsend is known for her vocals and melodic writing style. Gaining attention with her single "I Won't Wait," which she wrote.

Stream "I Won't Wait" on Spotify.
